BEFORE YOUR FIRST STORY

A little clarity.
A better start.

Is this a website that generates videos?+

This site showcases the work. The engine runs locally with a coding agent: you share a repository, review a script, then generate and refine the video.

Do I need a separate paid model API?+

The Codex session workflow uses your existing agent environment, without a separate model API key. Your host account and usage terms still apply. Free local narration needs its own compatible runtime; you can also import authorized audio or start silently.

Will I get the voices heard in these demos?+

Not automatically. Some demos use private voice configurations that are not distributed. Public local presets and authorized audio import provide separate starting options.

What can I edit after export?+

The engine project retains structured story, animation, captions and source records for supported workflows. This is not a promise of a Premiere or CapCut project export.
